subject: [PATCH v2 09/12] mm/collapse: open-code collapse_single_pmd() in its two callers

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch removes the collapse_single_pmd() function and instead open-codes its functionality in two callers, khugepaged's walk and madvise_collapse(). The changes ensure that the locking contract is maintained by scanning under the lock held by each caller and dropping it before running the collapse. This change does not introduce any functional changes but simplifies the code by removing a redundant function call.
